title: Kylie Minogue, Jonathan Groff & Catherine Tate Join 'Bad Fairies' | United States
text:
Cynthia Erivo is rounding out her cast of magical beings with the latest 'Bad Fairies' news, which announced live on Thursday at the Hollywood Bowl.
‘The Beekeeper 2’ Teaser: Jason Statham Kicks Rogue Govt. Agent Butt To Metallica In First Look At Sequel‘Crystal Lake’s Linda Cardellini Used Pam Voorhees’ Grief As “Fuel For Her Rage,” Reveals Her Favorite Kill Scenes: “Feels A Little Too Good”have joined her in the cast of the Warner Bros.
/Locksmith animated musical comedy, which is scheduled to premiere May 21, 2027 in theaters, in addition to teasing an orchestral arrangement of her character Jayne’s song “Hard to Believe”. Minogue will voice Clowder, the Cat Witch, Groff will voice Robin Goodfellow, and Tate will voice the Fairy Gothmother. They join Cynthia Erivo, who leads the film as Jayne Staplegun.
Minogue, who was in attendance at Thursday’s show, said in a statement, “I’m so excited to be part of, alongside the incredible Cynthia Erivo, Jonathan Groff and such a brilliant cast of voices. And getting to play both a cat and a witch? It’s a little bit magical, a little bit mischievous and a whole lot of fun.
”is an original musical comedy set in contemporary London that follows a delightfully subversive gang of fairies as they shake up their magical world. The film is penned by Deborah Frances-White. Previously announced cast includes Serrana Su-Ling Bliss as Fei Chang, James Acaster as Stickers, Dee Bradley Baker as Groundbeef and Ncuti Gatwa as Butterwort. ) are writing original songs, with Grammy-nominated Isabella “Machine” Summers composing the score and contributing to the songs.

Catherine Tate is represented by Jeremy Barber at UTA and Robert Taylor at The Artists Partnership.
